title: The rule hiding in plain sight
summary: Cameron Dicker made a 57-yard fair-catch kick with no time left in the first half. The rare option helped Los Angeles on the way to a 34–27 win.

timeline.label: End of first half
timeline.text: Denver interfered with Derius Davis’s fair-catch opportunity.

timeline.label: Untimed opportunity
timeline.text: After enforcement, Los Angeles chose a fair-catch kick rather than a scrimmage play.

timeline.label: The kick
timeline.text: Dicker made the 57-yard attempt with no defensive rush.

unusual: This was a fair-catch kick, not an ordinary field-goal snap. It was the first successful NFL attempt since 1976 and the longest recorded make.
explanations: Preparation for an obscure but existing rule explains the opportunity. This is an example of situational awareness working.
questions: Historical record descriptions are attributed to the Chargers and Hall of Fame.

sources.label: Hall of Fame: record and rule text
